messages.content: 你能幫我找一些遊戲資訊嗎？首先，我想知道在我的Playstation上玩《決勝時刻》可以獲得哪些獎勵。其次，我對Xbox上《國際足盟大賽》第三關的分數和排名很感興趣。第三，我想知道《刺客教條》的所有任務。最後，我想知道在我的PC上玩《要塞英雄》時可以獲得哪些「大師」獎杯等級的獎勵。

function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores.

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards.

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards.

message.reasoning:
We need to call three functions:

1) For PlayStation "Call of Duty" (assuming that's 《決勝時刻》). Use game_rewards_get with game="Call of Duty", platform="PS". We also might specify trophy? They ask "can get what rewards." So we don't set mission or trophy.

2) For Xbox "International Football Association Championship"? That's likely FIFA? But they say "國際足盟大賽" maybe "FIFA World Cup"? Let's assume it's "World Cup Soccer" but not sure. We'll use game="FIFA World Cup" or "FIFA" etc. Level=3. Platform="XBOX". Need score & ranking. Use game_scores_get with game="FIFA World Cup", platform="XBOX", level=3.

But there may be no such game; but we'll just pass as given.

3) All missions for Assassin's Creed. Use game_missions_list with game="Assassin's Creed".

4) Rewards for Master trophies in PC version of "Fortress Heroes" (?) Actually "Heroes of the Fortress" maybe "Fortnite"? Wait "要塞英雄" could be "Fortress Hero" maybe "Fortnite"? Not sure. But they mention "Master cup levels" so probably "Fortnite" has Trophy system like "Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master". So we will request rewards for master trophy. Game="Fortnite", platform="PC", trophy="Master".

Thus four calls.

Let's produce JSON responses accordingly.
